commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Search Swift packages by keyword. Supports inline filters such as stars:>500, platform:ios,linux, last_activity:>2025-01-01 and product:library inside the query.

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get details for a package: summary, authors, history, activity, dependencies, license, stars, products, data race safety, latest stable version, default branch and keywords.

commands.name: get-package-readme
commands.summary: Get the rendered README text of a package.

commands.name: get-package-releases
commands.summary: Get the release notes of a package, newest first: version, release date and changes.

commands.name: get-package-builds
commands.summary: Get a package's build compatibility matrix: one row per platform per Swift version, with results for the latest stable release and the default branch, plus build ids.

commands.name: get-build
commands.summary: Get one build's status, Swift version, platform, build command and full build log by build id (UUID).

commands.name: list-author-packages
commands.summary: List all packages by an author/owner as a JSON package collection (repo URL, summary, license, keywords, versions with verified compatibility).

commands.name: list-keyword-packages
commands.summary: List packages tagged with a keyword/topic, e.g. networking, 20 per page.

commands.name: get-collection
commands.summary: List the packages in a curated custom package collection, e.g. sswg-graduated.

commands.name: get-documentation-index
commands.summary: Get the DocC documentation navigation index (modules, symbols, articles with paths) for a package version.

commands.name: get-documentation-page
commands.summary: Get a DocC documentation page as JSON (abstract, overview content, topic sections) for a module or symbol path in a package version.

commands.name: get-package-score
commands.summary: Get a package's maintainer information: total package score and the per-trait score breakdown used for search ranking.

commands.name: list-recent-builds
commands.summary: List the most recent builds across all packages (build monitor): package, author, status, time, reference, Swift version and platform.

commands.name: list-recent-activity
commands.summary: List recently added packages and recent package releases from the home page.

commands.name: get-swift6-readiness
commands.summary: Get the Ready for Swift 6 stats: time series of packages with zero data race safety errors and total errors, for all packages and subsets.
